open_points.subject: perform_service_operation and ServiceCallStep.run
open_points.text: perform_service_operation: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that a call of an operation for which service_may_call answers may_call false for the calling service is refused with the OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS member of = models.RefusalKind after identify_service and service_may_call alone, before any other module is called, and changes nothing, for every pair of a member of = models.ServiceName and a member of = models.ServiceOperation for which service_may_call so answers; that a token held by no service is refused with the NO_VALID_TOKEN member of = models.RefusalKind exactly as a wrong one; that a repeat of the ADD_ROOM member or the PUBLISH_ARTIFACT_POINTER member of = models.ServiceOperation carrying an earlier request id, from a service without that right, is refused with the OUTSIDE_SERVICE_RIGHTS member of = models.RefusalKind, never answered as a repeat; and that a call acts with an ActingPrincipal of the AGENT_VIA_KERNEL member of = models.PrincipalKind exactly when service_may_call answered agent_authority true for it, and otherwise with one of the SERVICE member of = models.PrincipalKind and no session_id.
open_points.other_text: ServiceCallStep.run: [TEST_EVIDENCE] A test MUST show that a publish or a withdrawal is accepted from a service only for the CABINET_KERNEL member of = models.ServiceName acting for a session whose granted set holds the pointer's project, the publish recording Kernel and that session as its publisher, and that Kernel withdrawing a pointer of a project outside its session's set is refused with the AGENT_CALL_REFUSED member of = models.RefusalKind and changes nothing.
open_points.question: Must agent_authority remain restricted to CABINET_KERNEL, or must the publish/withdraw evidence allow every service for which service_may_call answers agent_authority true?
